charter: ADR-0177 COMPLETE wide-versus-split replica benchmark: Bun owner

disclosures: Confirmed rows use direct INSERT batches. The candidate-specific INSERT statement differs only by installed schema; the 5,000-row transaction loop and exact V1 proxy generator are structurally identical.
Blob membership uses direct candidate-specific INSERT/UPDATE statements in an identical index loop. Real blob capture requires the layout-independent file store.
Parked scalar intents use direct candidate-specific INSERT/UPDATE statements in an identical address loop because no store API creates an already parked lane.

measurement.timing: milliseconds; per-address for pointRead, laneWrite, and docAppend; per operation for all other metrics
measurement.statementCounts: run() and all() calls observed at the production SqliteDatabase adapter, retained per raw timing sample
measurement.rowsCounterLimitation: SQLite embedded APIs expose no rows-read/rows-written counters, unlike Durable Object SqlStorageCursor; statement counts and query plans are the measurable proxies.

workloadDecisions: Smoke uses one candidate repetition and reduced per-metric samples; full uses three repetitions and alternates the requested first candidate.
Lane writes alternate confirmed existing addresses and benchmark-only fresh addresses within every batch.
Fact-install pages alternate updates to confirmed fixture addresses and fresh addresses.
Tombstone pages walk eligible multiples of 100 from the end of the fixture, then restore a pending intent before timing so every target owns document, blob, and intent state.
Relation counts include every installed user table, including the shared meta relation, rather than omitting useful stronger evidence.
installedSchemaEncoding: JSON array of non-internal sqlite_schema tables and indexes ordered by type and name
